moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: I resigned from Anthropic today… Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self‑improving super‑intelligence and gambling with our lives.
moments.why: A high‑profile researcher resigns with an apocalyptic warning, igniting mass debate about AI safety—views exceeded 100M quickly.

moments.author: Hideo Kojima
moments.quote: Physint is an important project… we spent three months searching tirelessly for a new partner… we found in Xbox a partner with whom we share a common vision for the future.
moments.why: Kojima’s flagship game switches from PlayStation to Xbox, shocking the gaming world and branding console war headlines.

moments.author: Asha Sharma
moments.quote: We’re honored that Kojima‑san has chosen XBOX to work with KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS on PHYSINT.
moments.why: Xbox CEO publicly celebrates landing Kojima’s Physint after Sony dropped it—a rare studio‑level platform shift.

moments.author: Bobak Ha’Eri (via news)
moments.quote: X is still the king of college football, and frankly, live sports.
moments.why: After speculation X's decline, a sharp quote re‑affirms it remains the go‑to for real‑time sports culture, especially among men.
